query:
SELECT
                            kind,
                            key,
                            folder_id,
                            message_id,
                            sequence,
                            received_at,
                            fingerprint,
                            CASE WHEN kind = 'draft' THEN
                                jsonb_set(document, '{input,content}', jsonb_build_object(
                                    'message_id', document #> '{input,content,message_id}'
                                ))
                            ELSE document END AS "document!",
                            body
                        FROM
                            imap_state_entries
                        WHERE
                            link_id = $1
                            AND kind = ANY ($2)
